reason: Non-ruminated means the endosperm is smooth, not ruminate. The target is the negation of the ruminate value. I could not find FLOPO_0991205 in the value-term file, so I did not check it.
Not cordate means not heart-shaped.
A pseudo-umbel is an umbel-like inflorescence. The match is loose but acceptable.
Septicide is the noun form of septicidal, a capsule dehiscence type.
This is a narrow width. The 'very' only adds degree, which the broader target drops.
The smell is apple-like, and 'odorous' loses that. Map it to odorous only if the smell type is kept as a separate value.
Blanched means made white or pale, so 'white' is the nearest colour.
Densely foliated means leafy. The density is lost, but this is the usual handling of degree words.
Intertwined is the same as tangled.
Irregularly distributed is an irregular spatial pattern.
Left-twining gives the direction of twining (sinistrorse). 'Climbing' loses the direction. Use a twining or direction value if one exists.
The negation of notched.
Penninervous means pinnately veined.
Poorly visible means inconspicuous.
Saucer-like is saucer-shaped.
Finely ridged is ridged. The 'finely' is a degree word that gets dropped.
Incrusted means covered with a crust. The crust is not necessarily calcium, so 'calcified' adds a claim the word does not make.
Non-sticky means non-adhesive.
Antler-like describes a particular branching shape. 'Branched' loses the shape. Reject it or use a shape term.
Perceptible means can be detected. It does not mean conspicuous, which means easily seen.
Shortly spaced means closely spaced, which is crowded.
Subglobular is nearly spherical.
Enormous means a greatly increased size.
A false raceme (pseudoraceme) is a raceme-like inflorescence.
Tuber-forming means tubers are present.
Digitately nerved means several main veins radiate from one point, which is actinodromous.
The word means wavy-woolly. 'Lanate' loses the wavy part of the hair form.
Subvaginate means somewhat sheathing. That is not the same as clasping (amplexicaul), so the target loses the sheath.
The word is a mix of racemose and umbellate. 'Umbelliform' loses the racemose half.
Aporose means without pores, which is imperforate.
This is a loose match to leaf-like, since a leaflet is a leaf part.
A forb is a growth form, a non-grass herb. 'Herbaceous' loses the exclusion of grasses.
Ringlike is ring-shaped.
Caliculate means having an epicalyx.
Efibrillose means without fibrils.
Summer-green plants lose their leaves in the cold season, so this is deciduous.
Cannelé means grooved or fluted, which is furrowed.
Rugate is a variant of rugose.
The word is a mix of cymose and corymbose. 'Corymb-like' loses the cymose half.
Explanate means spread out flat.
The teeth are callose, meaning tipped with a hard callus. 'Dentated' loses the callose and the fineness of denticulate.
Floppy means limp, which is flexible.
Resinous-dotted means dotted with resin glands, which is gland-dotted.
'Neutral' means sexless or sterile only for florets and flowers. For other parts it is ambiguous, for example pH or colour.
Funiculate means having a funicle.
Fawny is a yellowish brown.
Short-tipped is a general description. It does not mean mucronulate, which is a specific small point.
Coniform is cone-shaped.
On these parts, 'falling' means falling off early (caducous), which is deciduous. The constraint already limits it to those parts.
On an involucre, not calyculate means no calyculus (outer small bracts), so epicalyx absent is a fair match.
